Subject: RE: FinHealth security & private deployment - post-call recap

Thanks — I reviewed FinHealth's responses and put together a short technical note to address the networking and deployment questions. High level: 

- Redwood Private (VPC): supports customer-owned VPC peering and private routing. Customer can restrict egress with NAT gateways and route tables; we support private link style connectivity to avoid public endpoints.
- Data residency: production workloads can be pinned to a region (us-east or us-west) and we can enforce tenancy isolation for your account.
- Key management: we integrate with customer KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) for at-rest encryption keys; HSM integrations are available as part of an enterprise package.
- On-prem / air-gapped: we offer an on-prem package. Air-gapped deployments are possible but require customer-provided hardware and an ops window for offline package installation and updates — we’ll need procurement lead time and a scoped change control process.

I’ve sketched a simple deployment diagram and noted where we would place KV caches and model artifacts for a Private installation. I’ve uploaded the sketch here: https://drive.google.com/diagram_v1 (deployment_diagram_v1.pdf).

For the questionnaire, I’ve flagged a few items that need engineering confirmation (see question IDs 12, 19, 22 in the attached). I suggest we cover those on the deep-dive.

- Monica
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
